title: net2 gate on net1 v6: round 18's ensemble at teacher gain 0.5 on validation campaign seed 11
description: On every validation family against net1 v6's rule with campaign seed 21 (exp-net2-eval-v6-veto-166), one of seven candidates met every gate condition: r18e05, round 7e's recipe on v6 (round 18's three gate3 DAgger students at teacher gain 0.5 as one policy on their mean beliefs, the stock-flow switch at 0.5, q unsharpened, copies handled by the fixed rule; release model-net2-v6-veto). Five-family mean +0.017, cubic-first-60 +0.049 (+0.017 to +0.085), new-20 competition +0.031 (+0.006 to +0.056), copies -0.022 (-0.058 to +0.017). It was chosen on those episodes, so this runs it alone, unchanged, through the gate (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py, the rule fixed before the first gate) on the same validation links with campaign seed 11, new episodes chosen by nothing, next to the fixed rule on net1 v6 (u = 0.25), the share rule (k = 0.5 and 1) and BBRv3, on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s. If it passes, it goes to its one run on the test links.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule6" "$N" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$N" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v6=$OUT/rule6/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-r18e05-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT" rule-v6
